result.fundName: Parag Parikh Flexi Cap Fund - Direct Plan - Growth

insights: Parag Parikh Flexi Cap Fund - Direct Plan - Growth decisively outperforms its benchmark on rolling returns by 4.63% (19.30% vs 14.67%).
Beat the benchmark in 100.0% of rolling windows — strong consistency for a Equity: Flexi Cap.
Risk-adjusted returns are superior: Sharpe 1.13 vs benchmark 0.64, Sortino 1.40.
Defensive profile: beta 0.60 with 26% lower volatility than the benchmark.
Positive alpha of 8.14% suggests manager skill beyond market exposure (info ratio 0.35).
Higher drawdown risk: fund max drawdown -31.20% vs benchmark -38.11%.
Rolling return range spans 4.09% to 33.95% (29.86 pp spread) — consistency score 100.
This fund satisfies all three Golden Triangle conditions.
